## 5. QA Engineer Conclusion & Recommendation

The audit confirms that the current database content has systemic quality and architectural flaws:
1. **Synthetic & Placeholder Questions:** 19 of the 21 topics currently store synthetic placeholder challenge text instead of canonical interview problems.
2. **Pre-Solved Starter Codes:** Many starter codes leak the complete solution in both JavaScript and Python, defeating the purpose of placement practice.
3. **Weak Test Suites:** Problems frequently have fewer than 4 hidden test cases, and many can be bypassed by trivial one-liners like `sorted(nums)`.
4. **Missing Pedagogy:** 98%+ of problems lack 3 tiered approaches (brute/better/optimal) with full multi-language code snippets and verified step-by-step visualizers.

**Action Plan:** Proceed to execute the content generation pipeline grounded in the 21 verified blueprints created in Step 1, replacing the defective stored content with verified canonical placement problems.
